h: Even Wisdom and Strength Depend on the Help of Hashem

p: מֵבִיא עַל זֶה הַפָּסוּק (קֹהֶלֶת ט, יא)
"I returned and saw under the sun
that the race is not to the swift,
nor the battle to the mighty,
And this is along the lines of what we said
"The king is not saved by a great army":
for "whoever is greater than his fellow,
his inclination is greater than he,"
"A mighty man is not saved by great strength":
the mighty man is one who conquers his inclination;
עַל יְדֵי רָב כֹּחַ שֶׁלּוֹ לְבַד
by his own great strength alone,
אִם אֵין לוֹ עֵזֶר הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
if he does not have the help of Hashem Yisbarach,
וְאִלְמָלֵא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא שֶׁעוֹזֵר לוֹ
and were it not that the Holy One, blessed be He, helps him,
he could not overcome it, etc."
"A horse is a false hope for salvation" (Tehillim 33:17)
refers to the men of deeds,
who ran before Me like horses, etc."
"The eye of Hashem is upon those who fear Him,
upon those who hope for His kindness";
that he know that by his own strength alone
רַק מַה שֶּׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עוֹזֵר לוֹ
only what Hashem Yisbarach helps him
And this is the meaning of the pasuk cited above:
"that the race is not to the swift"
corresponds to "A horse is a false hope for salvation";
for running is found with horses,
"You have run with footmen and they wearied you,
so how will you compete with horses?";
"until the horse runs and saves, etc."
נֶגֶד גִּבּוֹר לֹא יִנָּצֵל בְּרָב כֹּחַ
corresponds to "A mighty man is not saved by great strength."
And it says "nor the battle to the mighty,"
is the battle against the inclination,
and through his own might alone,
that is, the bread of Torah;
"The kohanim did not say, Where is Hashem?";
for whoever does not search for it as for hidden treasures
that he recognize the power of the Giver,
and that his occupation with Torah be for its own sake
that the Torah shine for him into the heart,
And it says "nor riches to the understanding":
that he is rich in Torah;
He Who made this one wise";
and so in the Midrash (Tanchuma Ki Sisa 3):
"'But the satiety of the rich, etc.' (Koheles 5:11)
it speaks of those rich in Torah,
and it does not let him sleep."
"And those who handle the Torah did not know Me";
for even one who holds fast to Torah,
and is among those who handle the Torah,
that they did not merit the secret of Daas,
that it enter the depth of the heart,
and they did not merit the dew of Atika,
and this is "not riches to the understanding."
and such a one has favor,
that even if he acts, Heaven forbid,
nevertheless his Torah is not rejected,
"Rabbi Meir learned from the mouth of Acher
And of the pomegranate it is found (there, 27a)
that they are full of mitzvos like a pomegranate.
That is, a Torah scholar like Acher,
that he is not lost, Heaven forbid;
and as it says there regarding Rabbi Yochanan,
the smoke ceased from the grave of Acher.
for sometimes he can corrupt himself
אַיֵּה סוֹפֵר אַיֵּה שׁוֹקֵל וְכוּלֵּי (יְשַׁעְיָהוּ לג, יח)
"'Where is the scribe, where is the weigher, etc.' (Yeshayahu 33:18)
and we learned in the Mishnah (Sanhedrin 90a):
"they have no share in the World to Come";
for nevertheless it was ruled about them in the Mishnah
and only the expounders of allusions would say
that all of them come to the World to Come,
that whoever comes from the seed of Yaakov
But in the Mishnah the law was ruled
that they have no share in the World to Come;
and this is "nor favor to the knowledgeable":
that he can corrupt himself so much
And this is "for time and chance
אִם לֹא שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עוֹזֵר לוֹ
unless the Holy One, blessed be He, helps him,
"Behold, the eye of Hashem is upon those who fear Him,
upon those who hope for His kindness."
"Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, etc.";
שֶׁבָּא מִיָּדוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
that it comes from the hand of the Holy One, blessed be He,
and from the power of the Torah,
כִּי אִם בְּזֹאת יִתְהַלֵּל (יִרְמְיָהוּ ט, כג)
that he know that all is from the power of Hashem Yisbarach.
שֶׁאָמַר עָלָיו דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
of whom King David, peace be upon him, said
"But it was you, a man my equal";
for King David, peace be upon him,
was a chariot for the attribute of Malchus,
for prayer is from the attribute of Malchus,
he thought he himself would reign, etc.;
but it was Shlomo who would come from it."
And likewise we find in the Yerushalmi (Berachos chapter 4)
would compose a new prayer every day.
it is written about him in the Mishnah
And this is what it says,
אַף שֶׁהָיָה גָּדוֹל בַּתּוֹרָה כָּל כָּךְ
even though he was so great in Torah,
"time and chance happen to them all,"
for the evil inclination can corrupt him
and he lose everything, Heaven forbid.
And this is what it says:
כְּשֶׁאֵינָם בָּאִים מִן הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
"When they do not come from the Holy One, blessed be He,
in the end they cease from him."

p: אִיתָא (רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא פִּנְחָס, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רנז, א)
it is found (Ra'aya Mehemna, Pinchas, Zohar III 257a):
from the side of the three supernal levels,
and she is the daughter, fourth to them."
And this is along the lines of
מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב רד, א)
what is written in the holy Zohar (II 204a):
the secret of the three Avos,
who are united with the only daughter,
and she is crowned with them."
And Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קעה, ב)
and it is found in the holy Zohar (II 175b):
and Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him
and Yaakov is in the secret of Daas,
like Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
who is in the secret of Daas;
only Yaakov is from the outer side
and Moshe from the inner side
"this one from the body and that one from the soul"
(as is written in Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 13);
and Daas is the inner aspect from Kesser Elyon.
the three holinesses of the Avos
and the holinesses of the first three Sefiros;
and it is through eating the three meals,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁסִּדְּרָן הָאֲרִ״י הַקָּדוֹשׁ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה
as the holy Arizal, of blessed memory, arranged them,
who is in the secret of Daas.
at the first two meals of Shabbos,
which correspond to Avraham and Yitzchak,
for effort is needed from the side of man
"And those who handle the Torah did not know Me,"
when he already merits the secret of Daas
and merits favor from Hashem Yisbarach,
כָּל שֶׁלֹּא קִלְקֵל חַס וְשָׁלוֹם לְגַמְרֵי
so long as he has not, Heaven forbid, entirely corrupted himself
there is not so much need
they did not institute at this meal
